nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $n \in \mathbb N$, and let $(u, v)$ and $(h, k)$ be elements of the Farey series $\mathcal F_n$ of order $n$ over $F$, read as the fractions $u/v$ and $h/k$. Then $u/v$ and $h/k$ are neighbours in $\mathcal F_n$ if and only if the polynomial $uk - hv$ has degree $0$, that is, $uk - hv$ is a nonzero constant.
nodes.title: Neighbour criterion for the polynomial Farey series

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and let $n \in \mathbb N$. Two pairs $(u, v)$ and $(h, k)$ of polynomials over $F$, read as the fractions $u/v$ and $h/k$, are neighbours in the Farey series $\mathcal F_n$ of order $n$ over $F$ when $u/v$ is a $(\deg v)$-neighbour of $h/k$ in $\mathcal F_n$ and $h/k$ is a $(\deg k)$-neighbour of $u/v$ in $\mathcal F_n$. In particular, both fractions then lie in $\mathcal F_n$.
nodes.title: Neighbouring fractions in the polynomial Farey series

nodes.title: Degree neighbours in the polynomial Farey series

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and let $n \in \mathbb N$. For every pair $(u, v)$ of polynomials over $F$, the fraction $u/v$ is not a $(\deg v)$-neighbour of itself in the Farey series $\mathcal F_n$ of order $n$ over $F$.
nodes.title: No fraction is its own degree neighbour

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field. For every natural number $n \ge 1$, the pair $(1, X)$, that is, the fraction $1/X$, belongs to the Farey series $\mathcal F_n$ of order $n$ over $F$.

nodes.title: Integral part of a polynomial continued fraction

For every $i \in \mathbb{N}$, the term of index $i$ (counting from $0$) of the continued fraction $[a_0; a_1, \ldots, a_n]$ over $F(X)$ is the pair with partial numerator $1$ and partial denominator $a_{i+1}$ if $i < n$, and does not exist if $i \ge n$.

nodes.title: Number of neighbours of a polynomial Farey fraction

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $n$ a natural number. The Farey series $\mathcal{F}_n$ of order $n$ over $F$ is the set of pairs $(u, v)$ of polynomials in $F[x]$, read as the fraction $u / v$, such that $\deg u < \deg v \le n$, $u$ and $v$ are coprime, and $v$ is monic. Here $\deg 0 = -\infty$, so $u = 0$ is allowed.
nodes.title: Farey series over a field

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field. The value of a pair $(u, v)$ of polynomials in $F[x]$ is the rational function $u / v$ in the field $F(x)$ of rational functions over $F$ (it is $0$ when $v = 0$).
nodes.title: The fraction of a pair of polynomials

nodes.title: The fraction $0/1$ lies in every Farey series

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
